item.title: How Michael Sam overcame a troubled childhood to make NFL history
item.summary: In a historic move, Michael Sam came out as gay in 2014, positioning himself as a trailblazer in the NFL. Overcoming a difficult upbringing filled with personal loss and bullying, he discovered his love for football early on under his father’s guidance. Embracing his identity during his college years with uplifting support, Sam’s NFL career was fleeting, but he has since transitioned into a coaching role in the sport.
